best_plan.title: Tokyo Ghoul - Unravel

sections.label: Intro - sustained bass, simple harmony
Continued intro - steady bass tone
Building texture - block chords support denser harmony
Dense harmonic rhythm - static block chords keep LH still, avoiding leaps
Return to block harmony, melody rising toward D6
High melodic peak - octave displacement down to keep hand span manageable
Climax section - melody still high, kept displaced down an octave for playability
Melody returns to comfortable register, block harmony support
Final cadence - simple sustained bass

reductions.rationale: Original 12 notes/bar harmonic rhythm reduced to static block chords instead of arpeggios to eliminate LH leaps while preserving harmonic content, keeping demand within skill level 4
Melody peak (A5-F6) exceeds comfortable reach when combined with LH; octave displacement removes doubling need and keeps texture light with pedal tone
Climax harmony simplified to block chords without inner voice elaboration to keep LH manageable at 144bpm while melody remains high and displaced
6 notes/bar harmonic rhythm supported with static block chords rather than moving bass to reduce technical demand

best_plan.notes: Arrangement keeps melody continuous throughout, using octave displacement (-12) at bars 31-42 to handle the C5-G6 range within the player's 12-semitone reach. LH textures use only pedal_tone and block patterns throughout the piece (no arpeggio or broken_octave) to keep the hand stationary and avoid leap violations at the fast 144bpm tempo, suited to skill level 4. Displaced sections are bracketed by pedal_tone/block sections at natural register to smooth the transition and avoid abrupt jumps in perceived voicing.
